sources.entry: Pelican Panel - Web application for easy management of game servers, offering a user-friendly interface for deploying, configuring, and managing servers, server monitoring tools, and extensive customization options (fork of Pterodactyl). (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP/Docker
Pelican Panel | Game server control panel, the modern successor to Pterodactyl

summary.one_liner: Pelican Panel is a free, open-source web control panel for creating, deploying and managing game servers, with each server isolated in a Docker container through Wings.
summary.what_it_does: Provides a web UI for creating and managing game servers, with each server running in its own Docker container via the Wings component. The README lists a wide range of supported servers grouped as "eggs", including Minecraft, SteamCMD games, standalone games, Discord bots, voice servers, software such as Gitea and Grafana, programming runtimes, databases, S3/SFTP storage, and Prometheus/Loki monitoring. It is described as the modern successor to Pterodactyl. The README gives no detailed feature list beyond this, and the metadata from the awesome lists adds mentions of server monitoring and customization options.
use_cases: hosting a Minecraft server for a community
managing game servers for a hosting business
self-hosting Discord bots or voice servers like Mumble or Teamspeak
running Docker-isolated game servers on a personal machine
notable: Docker-isolated game servers managed through Wings
Pterodactyl successor and fork, with a modern web UI
Large catalog of community eggs, including Minecraft, SteamCMD games, and databases
Free and open source for personal servers, communities and hosts
caveats: README gives no installation or run instructions; setup details are in the external documentation
Requires Docker and the separate Wings component for game server isolation
